messages:
maria (Marketing PM): Quick sync: we need the benchmark narrative finished for next week's launch. Deliverables: final chart pack (latency vs cost), one-slide ROI example, and an inbound routing spec for SDRs. Who can take what?

alex (Content): I can do charts. Proposal: three visuals — 1) scatter overview (median cost vs P95 latency), 2) small-multiples of latency distributions for representative workloads, 3) one-cell ROI calculation for a 1M-token/mo app. Keep labels concise.

jamie (Product Marketing): For small-multiples, split by model variant (fp16 vs q4) and by profile (chat-short, completion-long, embeddings-batch). Use P50 and P95 bands. Add a 1-line takeaway under each chart.

ryan (Growth): Routing rules: tag users who read the benchmark article + use the pricing calc as "bench-engaged". If they also start a trial >1k tokens or open sales chat, auto-create a lead with suggested play. Payload should include customer_id, page, calc_result, trial_tokens, suggested_play.

maria (Marketing PM): Copy hooks: two subject line directions — technical and business. Need short hero paragraphs for both variants for A/B testing. Also need CTAs: run calc, sign up for webinar, request a benchmark session.

alex (Content): Draft subjects: Tech: "Cut P95 latency by milliseconds, not promises". Business: "Lower LLM infra costs for production apps". For visuals, annotate scatter with "P95 drives user experience" and include a small inset listing per-token cost assumptions.

jamie (Product Marketing): ROI slide: table cell with numbers: example app = 2k tokens/session, 50k sessions/mo -> monthly tokens=100M, switching to Redwood defaults reduces infra cost by ~X and P95 by ~Y, enabling 2x throughput. I'll generate exact numbers and a 70-word paragraph linking latency gains to retention.

ryan (Growth): Example webhook payload (JSON):
```
{
  "customer_id": "CUST-9876",
  "event": "benchmark_article_viewed",
  "calc_result": {"monthly_tokens": "1000000", "estimated_monthly_cost": "~$X"},
  "trial_token_usage": "12000",
  "suggested_play": "technical-demo"
}
```
I'll build the Intercom zap and add UTM tagging for variant tracking. Bench-engaged leads -> 24h email with ROI summary; SDR follow-up if calc_result > threshold.

bench-bot: [perf-sample] models=[rw-13b-fp16,rw-13b-q4,rw-7b-q4], profiles=[chat-short,completion-long,embeddings-batch] -> P50/P95 latency and token-cost estimates attached.

maria (Marketing PM): Plan: alex -> chart PNGs + alt text; jamie -> ROI slide + 70-word para; ryan -> routing spec + Intercom zap notes. I'll stitch assets into the blog and set up the A/B hero test. Any objections?

alex (Content): No objections. Accessibility note: include text tables under each chart. Also prefer PNG + SVG for design's use.

jamie (Product Marketing): Add a short webinar blurb: 30-minute technical session, demo visuals + Q&A. Title: "Decoding inference economics: practical tradeoffs for product teams."

ryan (Growth): I'll capture which CTA they click and tag leads accordingly. Also add a follow-up sequence: 24h ROI email, 3-day SDR nudge.

maria (Marketing PM): Great. If you need fresh bench numbers, ping bench-bot with `/bench regenerate profile=chat-short`. I'll loop in Design if icons are needed. Thanks team.
